animateIn.description: Plays the entrance once on mount.

primaryAction.description: The main call to action: { label, href?, onClick?, external?, doneLabel? }. With href it renders a link; without, a button that shows `doneLabel` for a moment after a press.

secondaryAction.description: The second call to action, same shape.

title.description: Your own headline. When set, the hero renders your content (HeroContent) in the chosen layout.

description.description: Your own content: one or two sentences under the title.

announcement.description: Your own content: a short link above the title for real news.

install.description: Your own content: the first command is shown with a copy button.

media.description: Your own content: a visual beside the copy in the split layout.

meta.description: Your own content: small facts under the actions.
